scope: Discord bot journeys, mechanics and functions, with web port priorities and existing web enabling flows

priorityGuide.P0: Critical: core gameplay, learning or an essential function on the applicable surface.
priorityGuide.P1: Important: useful normal play that can be omitted temporarily.
priorityGuide.P2: Low: optional optimization, ancillary or surface-mismatched content.
priorityGuide.P3: Very low: reference or diagnostic convenience.
priorityGuide.OUT: Outside the current surface scope; not a low priority rating.
